changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 14: deleted activity/error.ts and activity/budget.ts (ClaudeActivityError, createClaudeScanBudget's ActivityError construction) in favor of the shared ActivityError from @excitedjs/dreamux-utils; createClaudeScanBudget itself moved into activity/path.ts, unchanged in behavior. activity/cursor.ts's claudeQueryFingerprint (byte-identical to Codex's copy) was replaced by the same package's activityQueryFingerprint.
